data.title: Bitcoin’s Next Move Could Shake Stocks And Metals: Bloomberg Strategist Warns As Fidelity Sees Bull Run
data.description: Mike McGlone, a Bloomberg Intelligence senior commodity strategist, said on Sunday that Bitcoin (BTC) "may have to prove strength, because if it doesn't, dominoes could tumble" for stocks and metals, even as Fidelity's Jurrien Timmer said a new bull market for crypto could already be underway.McGlo…
